verdict: Yes, especially if you're close to Jaipur's gem trade. Zillionaire from Jaipur pitched unique stone jewellery on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Jaipur is one of the world's biggest centres for cutting coloured gemstones, which gives local founders access to stones and skilled karigars.
angle: Coloured gemstones such as emerald, ruby and semi-precious stones sell to fashion buyers, gift buyers and those who wear stones for astrological reasons. Certification from a recognised lab builds trust. Export buyers value Jaipur's craftsmanship.
